scripts.compile: bash scripts/ensure-tooling.sh circom && mkdir -p build && circom UsageBilling.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -o build/
scripts.contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute build/circuit_0000.zkey build/circuit_final.zkey --name='ArcenPay Ceremony' -e='arcenpay-random-entropy'
scripts.export-vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/circuit_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify build/verification_key.json proof/public.json proof/proof.json
scripts.build:all: npm run compile && npm run setup && npm run export-vkey && npm run deploy-artifacts
